entry.title: New: RES23-235 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF ACCOMMODATIONS, LOCAL TRANSPORTATION, AND MEALS, VALUED AT $5,500, TO THE CITY FROM THE INCHEON METROPOLITAN COUNCIL, FOR COUNCIL CHAIR TOMMY WATERS, COUNCILMEMBERS RADIANT CORDERO, MATT WEYER, TYLER DOS SANTOS-TAM, AND VAL AQUINO OKIMOTO, AND SISTER CITIES COORDINATOR BRAD KITSU, TO ATTEND THE CELEBRATION OF THE 20TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE INCHEON-HONOLULU SISTER CITY RELATIONSHIP IN INCHEON, REPUBLIC OF KOREA.

Latest action: Adopted.
